name: @xyb-community/bone-cancer-workbench

scripts.check: node scripts/build-version.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning demo/build-demo-data.mjs && node scripts/check-version.mjs && node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node scripts/check-schema.mjs && node scripts/check-schema-judgment.mjs && node scripts/check-wording.mjs && node scripts/check-demo-columns.mjs && node scripts/build-client.mjs --check && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test test/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-workbench-package.mjs . && node scripts/check-probe-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-version-literal.mjs && node scripts/check-static-refs.mjs && node scripts/check-choice-limit.mjs && node scripts/check-assertion-strength.mjs && node scripts/check-derivative-leftovers.mjs . && node scripts/check-trial-snapshot.mjs . --if-present && node scripts/check-primer-links.mjs
